reasoning: The source is attacker-controlled request parameters, but each value is passed through HtmlUtils.htmlEscapeHex before being inserted into HTML. Hex escaping converts characters such as <, >, &, " into safe HTML entities, neutralizing script injection. The escaped value is then placed inside a static <div> tag and returned via ResponseEntity, which is a rendering sink. Because the sanitization occurs before the sink and effectively neutralizes XSS vectors, the reported vulnerability does not constitute an exploitable XSS.

proof_of_concept.description: No PoC needed because the escaping mitigates XSS.
